commits.subject: Eval: vitadeck-150 allows up to 11 groups; notes sit on the line they describe
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The 0.14.0 main eval failed vitadeck-150 only on `expected 5 to 9 groups, got 10`. The two extra groups were reasonable intra-part splits, so groups.max goes to 11 and expected.md allows such splits.

A run pinned "host passes `id -u` as LOCAL_UID" on the guard line, not on the `-e LOCAL_UID=` lines. The note rule now asks for the line that does what the note says.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
